design: Two fresh-context skill-assisted runs over the same ten development cases, followed by an independent judge blinded to version identity
original_source: Installed original captured before the update; hashes also recorded in provenance.json
git_import_note: The first Git commit already removes the original project-specific map dependency. The evaluated original snapshot preceded that packaging-only adjustment; its source hashes identify the exact input. The original project map is not distributed.
updated_source: skills/state-machine-verification; byte-identical to the evaluated updated snapshot
generation_scope: Analysis only; use supplied facts and relevant skill references; no external browsing, implementation or access to the scoring rubric
judge_scope: cases.md, rubric.json and the two answer files only; no skill source or version key
promotion_basis: User-requested explicit optional design checks; no material regression observed in these ten cases. Comparative superiority was not established.
